1.caption: What factor is most important to you when choosing packaging? KartonWorks studies the unique requirements of each business. We calculate maximum strength through BCT and ECT indicators.

2.caption: What does a product need to sell itself on the shelf? Properly designed corrugated cardboard packaging directly affects sales volume.

3.caption: Happy 35th anniversary of Independence! 35 years — a year of independent development, labor, and creativity. The Karton Works Factory team congratulates all its partners.

4.caption: Your competitor relies on 'luck' when choosing a packager. You — on BCT and ECT numbers. At KWF, every box undergoes laboratory testing.

5.caption: We guarantee that your product will arrive 100% intact on long transit routes. Each pallet is tightly wrapped according to standards.

6.caption: Fast and timely delivery of quality corrugated packaging products to all regions of Uzbekistan has been established.

hero.subtitle: Karton Works Factory
hero.title: About the Company
hero.description: Karton Works Factory (KWF) is a modern corrugated packaging manufacturing plant located in the Khorezm region. We design and manufacture high-quality 3 and 5-layer corrugated cardboard boxes for major manufacturers, exporters, and distributors.

mission.title: Production capacity and our mission
mission.p1: We do not just produce boxes, but ensure the supply chain security of our clients. Every product is manufactured based on engineering calculations so that it is not damaged during transport and fully complies with loading standards.
mission.p2: Our factory produces packaging for food, textile, agricultural (fruit and vegetable export), chemical, and heavy industry enterprises.

hero.subtitle: Services and Solutions
hero.title: Corrugated Packaging Services
hero.desc: A full cycle from design to delivery of the finished product to your warehouse. Solutions that reduce costs and increase protection for every business sector.

services.title: Corrugated Box Production
services.desc: Standard and non-standard size boxes made of 3 and 5-layer corrugated cardboard. Structures that ensure transportation, storage, and product safety.

services.title: Premium White Packaging (WhiteLiner)
services.desc: Premium boxes with a white outer liner. Enhances branding and visual prestige with high-precision flexo printing.

services.title: Shelf Ready Packaging (SRP)
services.desc: Perforated boxes ready to be placed directly from the warehouse to retail shelves. Saves up to 50% merchandising time.

services.title: Express Batches (48 hours)
services.desc: For urgent orders, production and dispatch of up to 50,000 boxes in 2-3 working days. Repeat orders in 24 hours.
